objectives.title: Use the Snowflake AI Data Cloud architecture
Manage Snowflake accounts and virtual warehouses
Perform data loading, unloading, and transformation
Use structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data

study_focus: Use the Snowflake AI Data Cloud architecture
Understand core account identifiers and basic setups
domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses in depth on the core architecture of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including account access, identifiers, and general setup configurations required for cloud database environments and administrative tasks.

study_focus: Manage Snowflake accounts and virtual warehouses
Configure resource monitors and compute resources
domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers standard account administration tasks and the management of virtual warehouses used for executing queries, running analytical operations, and loading large workloads efficiently across your organization database infrastructure.

study_focus: Perform data loading, unloading, and transformation
Configure internal and external data stages
domain_guidance.summary: This domain addresses data loading, unloading, and transformation procedures using internal and external stages, bulk loading techniques, and continuous data movement mechanisms across multiple distinct environments and cloud storage providers.

study_focus: Use structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
Query variants and files effectively within tables
domain_guidance.summary: This domain examines specific methods for storing, managing, and querying structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data types within Snowflake database tables for diverse analytical workloads and modern data lakehouse architectures.

study_focus: Analyze query profiles and execution metrics
domain_guidance.summary: This domain explores query performance monitoring, advanced optimization techniques, and error logging configurations for base tables to ensure efficient execution times and optimal resource usage across all active virtual warehouses.

study_focus: Manage role-based access control and shares
domain_guidance.summary: This domain pertains to securing sensitive data objects, establishing structured access control privileges, and enabling secure data sharing mechanisms across multiple accounts and external organizations while meeting strict governance mandates.

study_focus: Configure drivers, connectors, and client tools
domain_guidance.summary: This domain deals with setting up reliable connectivity using Snowsight, native drivers, specific connectors, and various external client applications to interact smoothly and securely with your cloud databases and backend data services.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Ensure you understand authentication methods like MFA and SSO, manage your time carefully across all exam domains, and check with Snowflake for the current certification path.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The SnowPro program policies utilize a scaled score ranging from 0 to 1000, with a program-wide passing scaled score of 750 required to successfully pass the examination.
The exact duration details and time limits are located on the official Exam Details tab or study guide, which should be verified directly through your Snowflake catalog guide documentation.
The official exam price is set at 175 United States Dollars, as clearly listed in the catalog and official program policies for the certification process and associated testing fees.

editorial.overview: The SnowPro Core Certification examination evaluates knowledge of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud architecture, account management, data loading procedures, and performance optimization techniques. Certified by Snowflake, this professional exam covers core data operations, structured and semi-structured file handling, and connectivity options designed for modern cloud data professionals working within enterprise environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review official Snowflake documentation regarding internal and external stages, SQL commands like COPY INTO, and DML error logging options. Practice configuring tables, managing authentication methods, and utilizing Snowsight for database tasks to ensure you are fully prepared for the certification examination and related topics.

editorial.who_should_take: Data professionals, administrators, and developers with hands-on experience using Snowflake who want to validate their technical skills in managing warehouses, loading data, and configuring security controls.
